Gifted: Light.name: Gifted: Light
Gifted: Light.description:
🧬 Light, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you fire a thin beam that sears skin about twenty meters away, flare bright enough to dazzle a room, and light up a dark building.
📈 With training: beams nobody can dodge, decoy light doubles, beam-kick leaps, cutting lines that free the trapped and seal wounds, a guarding turn, a street-wide beam.
⚠️ A full beam to the eyes can blind for life.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as forcing light out cramps the muscles it leaves through.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Yuga Aoyama (Navel Laser).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Light.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Light family): Scale: the user builds light in the body and releases it from palms, chest or a player-chosen spot. A new adult user fires a thin beam about twenty meters that sears skin, flashes to dazzle a room, or lights a warehouse until they stop. More needs techniques. Limits: a beam burns but never shoves; its kick pushes the user back a step; mirrors bounce it, smoke, fog and rain scatter it, opaque cover stops it; no corners without a mirror; every beam reveals where the user stands; tinted visors or shut eyes blunt the dazzle. Quirk Strain: light: short beam, glow; moderate: dazzling flash, precise long beam, light double, beam-kick leap; heavy: cutting line, turning guard beam; severe: signature beam, disarming a whole scene. Type: Emitter. Law: a beam to the eyes can blind for life, so aiming at a face is serious assault; unlicensed public use is a crime even if nobody is hurt.
